source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text:
Hello Rakhi, thank you for the reply.

I am a mother and this book is written from my experiences as well as borrowed experiences. My book is about how new parents can set boundaries without awkward conversations and how visitors can behave around a newborn and new parents. Its a guide that answers the question every new Indian parent is too exhausted to answer - 'When can you visit, how long can you stay, and please don't kiss my baby.' I have added checklists, Do's & Don'ts tables, and some anecdotes. This is my first time as an author and I would appreciate your help with getting this paperback published successfully. Basically I would need help in fine-tuning the book which would be a delight to readers and in successfully publishing this book.

Could you please help me with the below:
1\. How should we go about it ?
2\. Also, what would be the price and timelines for this ?

value_updates.editorial_objective: Fine-tune the book so it is a delight to readers.

Hello Rakhi, I have accepted almost all the track changes. I have added a few more details. For some reason, I think the track changes are not properly shown (or maybe its shown, I am not sure) for the sections I have added. To be sure, I have highlighted the sections that I have added in YELLOW.

I want some clarity here:
1\. Is this correct sentencing "So, I used to eat before anyone or sometimes after everytime, basically it was on demand." ?
2\. For this section " The thing I needed most from my partner was not grand gestures. Sometimes, I needed him to answer the door when people came. Sometimes, its checking if my water bottle is filled, if my water bottle is near me, sometimes a hug. Sometimes just to check in on me. Sometimes to put a blanket on me. I needed him to manage the visitors so I did not have to. Small things. But they meant everything.")" - it does not feel like its my experience, it feels like I am wishing this happened. How to structure this so that it conveys that I experienced this. For example, he did check up on me, he used to fill my bottle and keep it within a hand's reach.

Also, lets go with the 2 edits you mentioned:
1\. So, I ate whenever I was hungry. Sometimes I ate before everyone else, and sometimes afterwards. My meals were completely on demand.
2\. The thing I needed most from my partner was not grand gestures. He answered the door when visitors arrived. He made sure my water bottle was always filled and within my reach. Sometimes he would simply check in on me, give me a hug, or put a blanket over me. He managed the visitors so I didn't have to. They were small acts, but they meant everything.
